title: Guarded Token Instantiation
goal: Ensure proof tokens can only be constructed by authorized module functions.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Token Types

hints: Initializing struct fields without a local variable in scope requires writing both the field name and its value.
Types defined inside a submodule must be qualified with the module path when referenced outside that module.
explanation: Constructing `Permission` requires matching its private field structure `_guard: ()`. Using field init shorthand `_guard` fails with `E0425` because no variable named `_guard` exists in local scope. Outside the `auth` module, `Permission` must be qualified as `auth::Permission`. Unqualified `Permission` fails with `E0412` because it is not imported into current scope.
